title: Local Stochastic Volatility Iterations
abstract: arXiv:2611.18214v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a calibration method for local stochastic volatility models that determines the leverage factor by a fixed-point iteration. Each iteration simulates the model with the current leverage factor and approximates the conditional expectation of the stochastic variance given the spot by a single regression in time and state, with a quasi-likelihood loss for positive responses. The resulting leverage factor is a smooth function of time and spot with relatively few parameters, which can in addition be refined directly against option quotes. We recalibrate the leverage factor to S&P 500 index options on the day of an interest rate announcement, keeping the parameters of a two-factor Bergomi model calibrated four weeks earlier. translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种局部随机波动率模型的校准方法，该方法通过不动点迭代来确定杠杆因子。每次迭代使用当前杠杆因子对模型进行模拟，并通过在时间和状态上的单次回归（采用针对正响应的拟似然损失函数）来近似给定现货价格条件下随机方差的条件期望。所得的杠杆因子是时间和现货价格的平滑函数，参数相对较少，此外还可以直接针对期权报价进行进一步精调。我们在利率公布当天将杠杆因子重新校准至标普500指数期权，同时保持四周前已校准的双因子Bergomi模型参数不变。经过五次迭代，分别具有63个和143个系数的杠杆因子在所报价的行权价范围内以几个基点的精度复现了拟合于市场报价的隐含波动率曲面，其中系数较少的杠杆因子除了在……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种基于不动点迭代校准局部随机波动率模型杠杆因子的新方法，仅用少量参数即可在几个基点误差内复现标普500指数期权的隐含波动率曲面。
en_tdlr: Proposes a fixed-point iteration calibration method for local stochastic volatility models that determines the leverage factor with relatively few parameters, reproducing the S&P 500 implied volatility surface within a few basis points.
